description: Associates an AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) certificate with AWS Elemental MediaConvert to enable encryption for content delivery.

Arn.description: The ARN of the ACM certificate to associate with MediaConvert.
Arn.markdownDescription:
The ARN of the ACM certificate to associate with MediaConvert.

---

Required: Yes  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 20  
Maximum Length: 2048  
Pattern: ^arn:aws(-[a-z]+)*:acm:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:certificate/[a-f0-9-]+$  
Update requires: Replacement
